characters.description: A powerful Wanderers ritualist, cleric, and builder who is expanding the guild settlement and its magical infrastructure. Joe works with a small ritual coven and is accustomed to solving difficult guild problems himself, even when that habit makes others depend on him.
characters.name: Joe

characters.description: The Wanderers commander who directs the guild's strategic response after a public message exposes the settlement and falsely claims it holds unlimited supplies.
characters.name: Aten

characters.description: The Wanderers vice guild leader and a practical organizer of settlement construction. Mike coordinates plans, resources, and compensation for guild projects, and looks to Joe and the ritual coven for magical building and defensive work.
characters.name: Mike

characters.description: A Wanderers guard whom Joe recognizes during an attack on the settlement. Joe saves Jay from an assassin's opening strike, then heals him while trying to survive the same enemy's poison and pursuit.
characters.name: Jay

characters.description: Joe's trusted logistician and a member of his established party. Jess monitors greenhouse production and warns Joe that personally fixing every guild problem encourages dependence while worsening his intimidating reputation.
characters.name: Jess

characters.description: A seasoned combatant in Joe's established Wanderers party.
characters.name: Experienced Party Member

characters.description: The experienced adviser in Joe's established party, now safely identified as Jaxon. He fights with living hand-weapons and dispatches durable enemies quickly.
characters.name: Jaxon

characters.description: A musician-combatant in Joe's established party.
characters.name: Bard

characters.description: A combatant and poison specialist in Joe's established party.
characters.name: Alexis

characters.description: A close-range duelist in Joe's established Wanderers party.
characters.name: Poppy

characters.description: A member of Joe's Ritualist coven who helps construct the black defensive wall around the Wanderers' central buildings.
characters.name: Hannah

characters.description: A member of Joe's Ritualist coven who contributes to the guild's magical construction work.
characters.name: Kirby

characters.description: A member of Joe's Ritualist coven who helps build the Wanderers' defensive wall.
characters.name: Robert

characters.description: Two distinct but unnamed members of Joe's Ritualist coven who assist with the Wanderers' magical construction. They work beside Hannah, Kirby, and Robert, contributing separate labor and developing skills within the group's shared projects.
characters.name: Unresolved Coven Members

characters.description: A cleric allied with Joe who recognizes that Joe has never claimed several level-based abilities from his altar.
characters.name: Crim

characters.description: The librarian associated with Pathfinder's Hall and a source of practical advancement guidance. Boris explains how professions differ from classes, recommends pairing gathering with production or refinement, and offers to research a specialization route.
characters.name: Boris

characters.description: An alchemist who offers to teach Joe the specialized Ritualistic Alchemist profession. Jake makes his support conditional on joining the Wanderers' expansion and receiving a workshop at the guild's future outpost in the next zone.
characters.name: Jake

characters.description: An Architects Union representative who negotiates with Joe after his building abilities alarm the organization. Daniela grants controlled access to eligible structures for blueprint study under a short agreement and evaluates the quality of his designs.
characters.name: Daniela

characters.description: The queen who rewards Joe with Essence Cycle, a magical sense that lets him perceive energy.
characters.name: Queen Marie

characters.description: The leader of a rival five-person party seeking the same advancement prize as Joe near an ancient coastal temple. Sam openly treats the expedition as a competition.
characters.name: Sam

characters.description: The kingdom's high cleric and a champion of elemental water. Aaron enforces the closure of a temple event site and confronts Joe's party when they find a lawful way through the blockade, treating their entry as defiance of his order.
characters.name: Aaron

characters.description: A weapon master who opens public polearm training in the Wanderers settlement. Everard pushes Joe into a punishing lesson intended both to teach practical weapon use and to reduce resentment among guild members.
characters.name: Everard

characters.description: An unnamed deity associated with fire and wrath who asks Joe to recover the Golden Tome for Crim.
characters.name: Fire-and-Wrath Deity

characters.description: A neighbor war chief hidden beneath a trial dungeon. Arthur retains his sanity near holy water despite the curse afflicting his people, and offers Joe a path to earn a limited summoning token through a solo combat quest.
characters.name: Arthur

characters.description: A powerful unknown being released when Bard places a golden idol on an altar. The entity's arrival produces destructive brown fire and follows Bard's request to add a new divine figure to Joe's pantheon for a specialization requirement.
characters.name: Freed Being

characters.description: The being released from Bard's golden idol, now identified as a powerful god linked to music, instruction, and covert political killing. Hansel joins Joe's pantheon, changes Pathfinder's Hall, and grants new benefits to Joe and Bard.
characters.name: Hansel

characters.description: The human monarch who presides over the judgment following the catastrophic siege plague. King Henry weighs the guild's accounts of the altered ritual, the war's financing, and Joe's acceptance of responsibility.
characters.name: King Henry

characters.description: A founder of the Wanderers who challenges the guild's leadership after the siege plague. Mr. Banks uses survivors' anger and the absence of members awaiting respawn to organize a no-confidence effort against Aten.
characters.name: Mr. Banks

characters.description: Joe's mother and an ally outside his immediate guild operations. Brenda helps Joe and Jess purchase large quantities of supplies through proxies and provides reliable market values when those goods are later sold to the Wanderers.
characters.name: Brenda

characters.description: The unnamed deity who serves as Joe's patron and grants his cleric abilities. The patron supplies several choices Joe failed to claim at earlier levels, though insufficient divine energy leaves one option unavailable.
characters.name: Joe's Patron

characters.description: An unnamed permanently lethal creature connected to a tightly restricted supply of preserved blood. Joe permits the material to be used only in rituals intended to contain the creature and places it beyond ordinary access.
characters.name: Unnamed Lethal Creature

characters.description: The permanently lethal creature now identified as Game Over. Hannah uses its preserved blood to alter the quarantine ritual.
characters.name: Game Over
